'''Griq''' was an astronomical object in the [[Unknown Regions]] of [[the galaxy]]<ref name="SWSystems" /> that was home to the [[pits of Griq]]. Whilst [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|on]] [[Pasaana]], [[C-3PO]] suggested a group of [[Resistance]] members return to the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' before [[Poe Dameron]] stated that the [[First Order]] would be waiting for them at the ''Falcon'', before [[Finn]] added the Order would then throw them in the pits of Griq.<ref name="TROS" />
